target.title: fix(ci): coalesce broad review lanes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Broad hot and normal review runs use `github.run_id` in their top-level
concurrency keys. Every scheduled run therefore creates another independent
self-continuing chain. With a full OpenClaw backlog, those chains accumulate
behind the single per-target publish job.

Fixes #523.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use stable hot and normal lane keys, with the existing target repository suffix,
so GitHub coalesces duplicate broad work per target. Exact-item, apply,
comment-sync, audit, retry, fanout, and repository-dispatch lanes retain their
existing independent keys.

This keeps shard-level review concurrency unchanged while preventing scheduled
backstops from multiplying permanent producers.

## User Impact

ClawSweeper should stop building multi-hour publish queues during sustained
OpenClaw review load. Exact reviews and mutation lanes remain independent.

## Evidence

- Live incident at 2026-07-12 21:10 UTC: 28 pending runs, oldest about 48
  minutes, with 10 hot and 12 normal broad runs behind one publisher.
- Actions runner-registration capacity: 10,000/10,000 remaining.
- `node --test test/sweep-workflow.test.ts` - 55/55 passed.
- Main, repair, and dashboard TypeScript builds passed using the linked pinned
  toolchain binaries.
- Active-surface, automation-limits, formatting, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; correctness confidence
  0.94.
